item.title: SuperCut - Early Access
item.creator: Tetrascape
item.description: Create a polished cinematic in 15 seconds or dive deep with advanced but intuitive tools: Live-Edit mode let's you jump into a camera to visually adjust, and Curve Editor allows you to fine-tune Position, Rotation, FOV, Daytime, and Speed-Curve. Edit history, templates, multi-select, multi-shot, multitrack, multiplayer, and more! Create your cinematic masterpiece today.

faqEntries.heading: I lost the Guide. How do I get it back?
faqEntries.content: Use /h. Interact with the Guide Card to open SuperCut. Tap Film School for a walkthrough.

faqEntries.heading: Do I have to save my cinematic?
faqEntries.content: No. Cinematics save as you work, including the ability to undo & redo your actions.

faqEntries.heading: Can friends use SuperCut with me?
faqEntries.content: Yes. By default each player can edit their own cinematic concurrently. You can enable editing the same cinematic at the same time via the Lock Granularity setting in the Guide Card's Settings menu.

faqEntries.heading: What are all the elements of a Cinematic?
faqEntries.content:
- Cameras are keyframes in your shots.
- Events allow you to trigger commands, particles, sounds, and more
- Shots are a sequence of cameras in a continuous path and also hold Events
- Tracks hold Shots and allow you to select the order in which the play
- A Cinematic is your whole recording. Each track can be assigned to a separate player to film from multiple concurrent angles

Each element is simple to use at the surface, but provides a deep level of customization to help you achieve the exact look you want.
The Guide Card is full of information to help you on your journey!

faqEntries.heading: How do I record my video?
faqEntries.content:
Once your Cinematic is ready, start recording with your favorite screen recording software & use the Clapper item to play your Cinematic.

If you have multiple tracks, you can assign a player to each track to film simultaneously, or switch through tracks to record one at a time.

faqEntries.heading: What is the quickest way to create a cinematic?
faqEntries.content:
1. Enter Edit Mode by attacking with the Guide Card item
2. Hold the Clapper item and use Record Movement
3. Fly along the desired path
4. Use the Clapper item again to confirm
Done!

item.howToTitle: How to record your first Cinematic

howToEntries.heading: Step 1: Enable Edit Mode
howToEntries.content: Hold the Guide Card and use the Edit Mode button

howToEntries.heading: Step 2: Record Movement
howToEntries.content: Hold the Clapper item and use Record Movement

howToEntries.heading: Step 4: Confirm
howToEntries.content: Use the Clapper item again to confirm

howToEntries.heading: Done!
howToEntries.content: Wanting to take it a step further? Learn more in the Guide Card!
